summary: Tamboran Resources Corp completed the acquisition of all subsidiaries of Falcon Oil & Gas Ltd via a plan of arrangement under British Columbia law. Tamboran issued 6,537,503 shares of common stock and paid $23.7M cash to Falcon for 98.1% equity interests in Falcon Australia and other entities. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transaction closed on May 28, 2026, with no stated premium or regulatory clock. Watch for integration risks and post-closing ownership dilution effects.
